acts.name: Read every book on the shelf
Listen to every record in the box
Beat every game on the drive
Watch every film in the cabinet
Watch the clock until it stops meaning anything
Watch the yard until it stops changing
Take the sheet off the piano
Wait for the apples to grow
Build a house with your hands
Raise a forest from a seed
Watch the village become a city
Watch a glacier carve a valley
Watch a volcano build an island
Watch the ice ages come and go
Search the dust for a nursery
Watch a comet circle the sun
Watch a sun live its life
Watch your world swallowed by its sun
Strike the crystal one last time
Watch the last stars burn out
Search the dark for anything still burning

notes.book_written: You wrote a whole book. Nobody will read it.
notes.built_house: A house of your own making, in the village.
notes.can_cook: You cooked a feast. You set two places, out of habit.
notes.charted_stars: You've mapped the sky. It will need redrawing.
notes.city_grown: The hamlet is a city. They never noticed you.
notes.comet_seen: A comet on a ten-million-year orbit. Company, of a sort.
notes.composed: You composed a thousand symphonies. The hall was empty.
notes.crystal_sung: You struck the crystal. The dust seemed to listen.
notes.drifted: The map you knew is wrong.
notes.empire_fell: The empire, fallen. Goats in the forum.
notes.empire_rose: An empire, risen out of the plain.
notes.explored_village: You walked every street of the village.
notes.family_done: The family died out. The city did not notice.
notes.forest_grown: A forest, older than any road you walked.
notes.found_almanac: A stained gardener's almanac, wedged in the kitchen shelf.
notes.found_chess: A chess set, in the cabinet.
notes.found_chess_note: Taped under the chessboard: 'Your move.' In your handwriting.
notes.found_crystal: A crystal that rings when you tap it.
notes.found_fossil: Bones in the stone. Something lived here.
notes.found_holes: Dark things that still glow, very faintly.
notes.found_ice_map: In the ruins: a drawing of the northern ice.
notes.found_letters: Letters in an unknown language. The attic.
notes.found_library: A university. Its halls go on and on.
notes.found_lumber: Beams and tools. Enough to build with.
notes.found_notebook: A blank leather notebook, in the desk.
notes.found_nursery: A dark nebula. Something is being born in it.
notes.found_old_message: An unsent message on the old computer, to someone with no name.
notes.found_paints: A roadside painting workshop. Paints, still wet somehow.
notes.found_photo: A folded photograph behind the clock. A smile you can't place.
notes.found_scores: A conservatory near the end of the road, full of unplayed scores.
notes.found_seeds: A tin of seeds, in the shed.
notes.found_shelf_note: A pressed flower bookmark, with a date older than you can place.
notes.found_sleeve_note: A note in a record sleeve: 'for when the quiet gets too loud'.
notes.found_telescope: A brass telescope, wrapped in oilcloth, in the attic.
notes.found_tv_note: A TV guide behind the set, every show circled. The circles are yours.
notes.found_village: Smoke over a cluster of roofs beside the road: a village.
notes.found_window_note: A pressed leaf behind the curtain. Autumn, once.
notes.garden_cleared: The weeds are gone. The earth is ready.
notes.garden_grown: Tomatoes. Beans. Nobody to share them with.
notes.glacier_done: A valley, carved by patient ice.
notes.heard_music: Music. You'd forgotten what a melody was for.
notes.heard_nothing: You listened for a signal. There was none.
notes.holes_gone: Even black holes run out of time.
notes.island_born: A volcano built an island, then the sea took it back.
notes.know_cycles: Rise, fall, forget. Round and round.
notes.know_garden: The almanac: everything wants light, water, patience.
notes.light_gone: No light. No heat. No motion.
notes.painted: A thousand canvases. Not one with a face.
notes.piano_learned: Your hands know the piano now.
notes.place_conservatory: A hall with a green roof beside the road.
notes.place_library: A university at the end of the road.
notes.second_empire: A second empire. The same mistakes under new banners.
notes.seen_layers: Layers in the rock. Time, written sideways.
notes.seen_world: The road goes everywhere, and ends nowhere.
notes.seen_yard: Outside the window, an overgrown yard. Bare earth.
notes.stars_out: The last stars have gone out.
notes.studied: You know how everything works. It changes nothing.
notes.sun_lived: The sun grew old. Swollen. Red.
notes.swallowed: Your world is gone, inside the light.
notes.wrote_history: A history of the empire, in your own hand.
